limits: t is the recorder host's clock (ms), not a device timestamp
the header has no frame type, rate or transmitter: a parity substream is a statistical probe, not proof of two frame types
the 'empty' recordings have no entry log, so their emptiness is unverified
nothing here changes a threshold or the firmware; nothing is written into data/

mode_description.raw: cosine of the raw amplitude vectors (nothing removed: the static channel dominates, so every lag is ~1)
mode_description.shape: each frame's own mean over subcarriers removed (Pearson across subcarriers); the static spectral SHAPE is kept
mode_description.timedemean: each frame divided by its own mean, then the per-subcarrier TIME mean removed (static channel gone). This is the primary variant and the one behind the ~0 lag-1 figure quoted earlier
mode_description.highpass: timedemean, plus a centred ~1 s moving mean removed (slow drift cannot masquerade as structure)
